purpose: Every correction the owner has had to make, as a failure class with its instances and a detector. Owner conditions 2026-11-17 (docs/self-evaluation.md): corrections must influence future planning and evaluation (7); the owner's corrective intervention must decrease (8); the self-improvement mechanism is not successful until it detects and corrects a previously observed class without the owner pointing it out again. An instance observed_by 'owner' is an intervention; observed_by 'mechanism' is a detection the owner did not have to make. Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (PR 68): discovering a defect, repairing it, and proving that a reusable mechanism would catch its recurrence are recorded apart. An instance observed_by 'review' was found by an independent review: it is evidence that the review worked, never a detection of this mechanism. by_detector marks an instance the class's own registered check found; the mechanism is successful only for such an instance, of a class the owner had already raised, that the mechanism also corrected. corrected_by says who repaired an instance; recurrence_check names the reusable check that was seen to catch it again.
